source.name: Water quality for agriculture, Irrigation and Drainage Paper 29 Rev.1, Table 1

scope: General irrigation restriction screening only. Not an Indian statutory contamination, drinking-water or food/feed standard. Crop, soil, climate and drainage assumptions need local professional review.
limits: SAR must be laboratory reported with complete sample identity; pair only with EC of the same sample/report. Exact shared SAR band boundaries are referred for review rather than silently assigning an overlapping interval. No crop-specific ion toxicity, amendment dose or overall suitable-water certificate follows.
